panels.title: Read Path Optimization
panels.body:
1. ZREVRANGE user_timeline:123 0 199
2. Get followed celebs: [1000, 2000]
3. MGET celeb_tweets:1000 celeb_tweets:2000
4. Merge and sort in application layer
5. Paginate using cursor (Snowflake ID)

panels.title: Latency Considerations
panels.body:
Pre-computed Redis reads are < 2ms.
Pulling from 50+ celebrities adds N network calls.

Mitigation: Heavily cache celebrity tweet lists
and hydrate full tweet content (text/media)
only for the top 20 visible tweets.
